title: Step 2: Creating & Evaluating Linear SVM Classifier in R - Predictions & Results

cues.en: Instructor: Okay, so let's go back to our classifier.
cues.zh: 好，回到分類器。

cues.en: So the pre-processing is done and now we are going to create our classifier.
cues.zh: 前處理已完成，現在建立分類器。

cues.en: Everything should go well.
cues.zh: 應該都會順利。

cues.en: I don't have to select this because mine was already selected.
cues.zh: 這裡我不用再選，因為我的已經選好了。

cues.en: So let's press command alt control plus enter to execute.
cues.zh: 按 Command 或 Control + Enter 執行。

cues.en: And here it is, classifier created.
cues.zh: 好，分類器建立完成。

cues.en: All good.
cues.zh: 一切正常。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: And now we can make some predictions of new observations, which are here to tested observations.
cues.zh: 現在可以預測新觀測值，也就是這裡測試集的觀測值。

cues.en: Let's do it.
cues.zh: 來做。

cues.en: Y pred, y pred.
cues.zh: y_pred，y_pred。

cues.en: All right, so let's have a look at Y pred.
cues.zh: 好，看看 y_pred。

cues.en: Y pred, so these are all the predictions of the tested observations that is for each user of the tested or classifier predicts
cues.zh: y_pred，這些是測試集所有觀測值的預測，也就是對測試集的每一位使用者，分類器預測

cues.en: if the user buys the SUV or not.
cues.zh: 他是否會購買 SUV。

cues.en: So let's compare the predictions with the truth which are contained in the test set.
cues.zh: 把預測與真實值比較，真實值包含在測試集中。

cues.en: So this column tells the truth about whether the users bought yes or no, the SUV.
cues.zh: 這一欄表示使用者實際是否購買 SUV。

cues.en: And this, the predictions there is are SVM classifier predicted whether each user bought yes or no, the SUV.
cues.zh: 而這裡是預測，也就是 SVM 分類器預測每位使用者是否購買 SUV。

cues.en: So let's look at for example, the, well, okay so all these first guys here were predicted not to buy the SUV.
cues.zh: 例如看看這些，前面這些人都被預測為不會購買 SUV。

cues.en: We have all zeros until the 103.
cues.zh: 到這裡的 103 之前都是 0。

cues.en: But here, as you can see we have some guys who actually bought the SUV, in reality is the 18, 19th, 20, and 22.
cues.zh: 但可以看到，有些人實際購買了 SUV，是第 18、19、20 和 22 位。

cues.en: So our classifier predicted that they didn't buy it and the truth is that they actually bought it.
cues.zh: 分類器預測他們沒有購買，但實際上有購買。

cues.en: So that's incorrect predictions.
cues.zh: 所以這些是錯誤預測。

cues.en: But let's look at the incorrect predictions in a more efficient way by looking at the confusion matrix.
cues.zh: 不過用混淆矩陣來看錯誤預測會更有效率。

cues.en: So let's select this line here and execute.
cues.zh: 選取並執行這一行。

cues.en: And now let's find out about the real number of incorrect predictions.
cues.zh: 現在看看實際有多少筆錯誤預測。

cues.en: So let's type CM here in the council and press enter.
cues.zh: 在主控台輸入 CM，按 Enter。

cues.en: And wow, that's actually a quite large number of incorrect predictions.
cues.zh: 哇，錯誤預測的數量還不少。

cues.en: And by the way, we don't obtain the same results as in Python because we have some random factors in the model.
cues.zh: 順帶一提，結果和 Python 不同，因為模型中存在一些隨機因素。

cues.en: And here we didn't specify a seed, so you might actually have some different results.
cues.zh: 而這裡沒有指定種子，所以你的結果可能也會不同。

cues.en: But the IDs here.
cues.zh: 但重點是這樣。

cues.en: So, okay, so let's look at now the the graph to see how it's doing.
cues.zh: 現在來看看圖，看看表現如何。

cues.en: So for those of you who actually didn't watch the Python tutorial about SVM, a good exercise is to try to guess what's going to happen.
cues.zh: 如果你沒有看過 Python 的 SVM 教學，可以做個練習，猜猜會發生什麼。

cues.en: That is what are gonna be the prediction regions what is going to be the prediction boundary what do you guess you will see?
cues.zh: 也就是預測區域會是什麼樣子？預測邊界會是什麼？你猜會看到什麼？

cues.en: So I will let you think for a second.
cues.zh: 我讓你想一下。

cues.en: You can pause on the video.
cues.zh: 可以暫停影片。

cues.en: And right now I'm gonna tell you, so as you notice we chose a linear kernel, which means that our SVM classifier is a linear classifier.
cues.zh: 現在我要揭曉。你注意到了，我們選擇線性核心，這代表 SVM 分類器是線性分類器。

cues.en: So as I explained in the logistic regression tutorials on Python and R, well, a linear classifier in 2D dimensional space is a straight line.
cues.zh: 就像 Python 與 R 的邏輯斯迴歸教學中解釋過的，二維空間中的線性分類器就是一條直線。

cues.en: So here I'm telling you this right now, we are gonna get a straight line not to get any disappointment because I know we improved our model with the K and N before we obtained a good prediction boundary that caught
cues.zh: 所以現在先告訴你，會得到一條直線，免得失望。我知道先前 KNN 改善了模型，得到不錯的預測邊界，能涵蓋

cues.en: you know, those users on the bottom right corner that actually bought the SUV, but who were incorrect predictions for logistic progression.
cues.zh: 右下角那些實際購買 SUV、但在邏輯斯迴歸中預測錯誤的使用者。

cues.en: Well, here it's also going to be some incorrect predictions for the linear SVM, because it's actually a linear classifier.
cues.zh: 這裡線性 SVM 也會有一些錯誤預測，因為它本來就是線性分類器。

cues.en: So let's look at the results right now.
cues.zh: 現在看看結果。

cues.en: Select this and press command and control press enter to execute, and here are the results.
cues.zh: 選取這段，按 Command 或 Control + Enter 執行，結果出來了。

cues.en: Okay?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: So as you can see, that's exactly what I just told you.
cues.zh: 可以看到，完全就是剛才說的情況。

cues.en: You know, those users here with a lower salary and the higher age, well, they actually bought the SUV in reality, because the points are green the points are the real observations.
cues.zh: 這些薪資較低、年齡較高的使用者，實際上購買了 SUV，因為點是綠色，點代表真實觀測值。

cues.en: But they fell into the red region here because since the linear classifiers is a straight line it couldn't, you know, make some kind of a curve here to catch all the red points
cues.zh: 但他們落在紅色區域，因為線性分類器是直線，無法在這裡彎曲，把所有紅點

cues.en: into the right place and therefore it caught some green points putting them in the red region.
cues.zh: 放到正確位置，因此也涵蓋了一些綠點，把它們放進紅色區域。

cues.en: So yeah, that's exactly the same as for logistic regression.
cues.zh: 所以和邏輯斯迴歸完全一樣。

cues.en: Sorry about the disappointment, but don't worry.
cues.zh: 可能讓你失望了，但別擔心。

cues.en: In the next section we will introduce a new kind of classifier, which will be, well the kernel SVM with a different kernel than linear kernel.
cues.zh: 下一節會介紹新的分類器，也就是使用非線性核心的核心 SVM。

cues.en: It's gonna be a Gaussian kernel or even we can try some more kernels.
cues.zh: 會用高斯核心，甚至也可以嘗試更多核心。

cues.en: Well, you can practice that yourself it can be very good practice for you.
cues.zh: 你可以自己試，會是很好的練習。

cues.en: But here, yes, it's a linear classifier.
cues.zh: 但這裡是線性分類器。

cues.en: So basically it's the same as logistic regression.
cues.zh: 所以基本上與邏輯斯迴歸相同。

cues.en: And if we look at the test set results is going to be the same.
cues.zh: 看測試集結果也會一樣。

cues.en: Let's have a look, and here's the test set.
cues.zh: 來看看，這就是測試集。

cues.en: Okay, so yeah, same thing.
cues.zh: 好，同樣的情況。

cues.en: Here, we have some users of higher age and and lower estimated salary who bought the SUV but fell into the red region again
cues.zh: 這裡有一些年齡較高、預估薪資較低的使用者購買了 SUV，卻再次落在紅色區域，

cues.en: because our class fair is straight line.
cues.zh: 因為分類器是直線。

cues.en: And that's the best you could do to classify those two points and place them into their corresponding category.
cues.zh: 這已經是把這兩類點分開、放進各自對應類別時能做到的最好結果。

cues.en: So a few incorrect predictions here a few incorrect predictions here.
cues.zh: 這裡有一些錯誤預測，這裡也有一些。

cues.en: And if you want you can count the number of incorrect predictions.
cues.zh: 你也可以數一數錯誤預測的數量。

cues.en: That is the number of green points in the red region plus the number of red points in the green region.
cues.zh: 也就是紅色區域中的綠點，加上綠色區域中的紅點。

cues.en: And you will count the number of incorrect predictions we found in the confusion matrix which was 20 incorrect predictions.
cues.zh: 數出來會和混淆矩陣中的錯誤預測數量相同，也就是 20 筆。

cues.en: But that's great that we have this result because that gives us the motivation to improve our classifier, improve our model and that's what we're gonna do in the next section.
cues.zh: 得到這個結果很好，因為它讓我們有動力改善分類器、改善模型，這就是下一節要做的事。

cues.en: So I look forward to seeing you in the next section and show you how we can substantially improve our classification model.
cues.zh: 期待下一節見到你，展示如何大幅改善分類模型。

cues.en: So I look forward to showing you the next level.
cues.zh: 很期待展示下一個層次。

cues.en: And until then, enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 在此之前，享受機器學習吧。
